title: A bit of everything
description: Five quick questions across science, geography, and the natural world.

questions.prompt: Which planet has the most moons in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn is currently known to have the most confirmed moons.

questions.prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all of Earth's land combined.

questions.prompt: Which part of a plant cell captures energy from sunlight?
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which absorbs light for photosynthesis.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington has been New Zealand's capital since 1865.

questions.prompt: Which animal is the only mammal capable of true flight?
questions.explanation: Bats generate lift with powered wing beats; the other animals glide.
